description: Get a tracking pixel for ONE email the owner asked to track. Returns an tag to put at the end of the HTML body before sending, and, given the links of the email (pass them by default), a tracked address for each link. Never use for plain-text emails or sensitive correspondence. After sending, keep watching with didtheyopen_new_opens on a schedule and tell the owner when it is opened, without waiting to be asked.

client_ref.description: Your own unique id for this email, e.g. "proposal-dana-2026-11-10". Reuse it on retries.

label.description: Recipient display name shown in the owner dashboard, e.g. "Dana Levi". Never an email address.

links.description: The link addresses (href) in the HTML body; pass them by default whenever the email has links. Returns a tracked address for each, so a click by the recipient also counts as opened, even in Apple Mail, which hides opens. Leave out only when the owner says not to track links. Unsubscribe, mailto and non-web links are never tracked.

sender_label.description: Which mailbox it was sent from. Default work.

name: didtheyopen_track_email
title: Track an email
